cases.title: Initiate drag event on draggable product item
cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item (li element with draggable='true') initiates a drag event capturing the product details.

cases.title: Capture product title during drag event
cases.description: Verify that the drag event captures the product's title identified by data-testid attributes such as 'product-title-1'.

cases.title: Capture product price during drag event
cases.description: Verify that the drag event captures the product's price identified by data-testid attributes such as 'product-price-1'.

cases.title: Drag and drop product item into drop area
cases.description: Verify that users can drag and drop a product item (e.g., data-testid='product-item-1') into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') to add it to the cart.

cases.title: Automatic cart display update upon drop
cases.description: Verify that upon dropping a product into the drop area, the cart display automatically updates such that the product title appears in .box2, the unit price in .box3, and the quantity in .box1.

cases.title: Support adding different and repeated products
cases.description: Verify that the system supports adding both different products and repeated products into the cart via drag and drop.

cases.title: Calculate and format total price for products in cart
cases.description: Verify that the system sums the prices of all products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displays it in the <div id="allMoney"> element.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and explicit scenarios are fully covered by the test cases without any blockers or missing scenarios.
All requirements and cases have been fully verified. The test cases map correctly to the explicit scenarios described in the requirements without any blockers, coverage gaps, or redundancy.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1 describes multiple distinct behaviors including initiating a drag event on 'li' elements with 'draggable=true', capturing the product's title, and capturing the product's price using specific data-testid attributes. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3 contains multiple distinct behaviors: allowing drag and drop of product items into the drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area'), updating cart display elements (.box2 for title, .box3 for unit price, .box1 for quantity), and supporting both different and repeated products. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5 contains multiple distinct behaviors: summing prices of all products in the cart, formatting the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol, and displaying the formatted total in the element with id='allMoney'.
